main.description: An environmental observation published by an autonomous monitoring node. The observationType field declares the domain; all domain-specific fields are optional to support partial nodes (e.g. PPM-only, weather-only).

observedAt.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of the observation period this record covers.

nodeId.description: Human-readable identifier for the physical node. e.g. 'napa-home-01'. Not the DID — the DID is the publisher identity, this is a stable local label.

observationType.description: The domain of this observation. Synthesis agents filter the firehose by this value. Nodes publish only the types they have data for.

summary.description: Plain language summary of conditions. Written for a general audience. The Bluesky post is truncated separately by the publisher to fit the 300-grapheme limit, so this field holds the full text rather than a post-sized one.

flagged.description: True if conditions in this domain warrant attention. Domain agents set this; synthesis agents aggregate across domains.

flagReason.description: Brief reason if flagged. Empty string if not flagged.

agentModel.description: The LLM or SLM used to produce this observation. e.g. 'claude-haiku-4-5', 'phi-4-mini', 'qwen2.5-3b'. Allows synthesis agents to weight observations by model capability if desired.

watershedData.description: Watershed-specific observation fields. All optional to support partial sensor deployments.

stationIds.description: USGS or other station identifiers contributing to this observation.

dischargeMinCfs.description: Minimum stream discharge in cubic feet per second across stations. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

dischargeMeanCfs.description: Mean stream discharge in cubic feet per second across stations. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

dischargeMaxCfs.description: Maximum stream discharge in cubic feet per second across stations. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

gageHeightMinFt.description: Minimum gage height in feet across stations. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

gageHeightMaxFt.description: Maximum gage height in feet across stations. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

floodStageThresholdFt.description: NWS flood stage threshold in feet for the primary station. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type. Not currently populated: no flood stage is configured for either Napa gauge.

sevenDayTrend.description: Direction of flow over the past 7 days.

stationId.description: Observation station identifier. e.g. 'KAPC' for Napa County Airport.

temperatureF.description: Current temperature in Fahrenheit. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

humidityPct.description: Relative humidity percentage. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

windSpeedMph.description: Wind speed in miles per hour. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

windGustMph.description: Wind gust speed in miles per hour. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

windDirectionDeg.description: Wind direction in degrees. 0/360=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W. NE (45°) indicates Diablo wind pattern. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

windPattern.description: Interpreted wind pattern. Diablo (NE/E offshore flow) dramatically increases fire risk. Derived from direction and speed by the publisher; omitted rather than guessed when the sector is ambiguous. 'valley' is never emitted — Napa Valley runs NNW-SSE, so up-valley flow shares a sector with marine air and direction alone cannot separate them.

precipMm24h.description: Precipitation in millimetres over the last 24 hours. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

activeAlerts.description: NWS alert event names in effect at observedAt, filtered by each alert's own onset/expires. e.g. ['Red Flag Warning', 'Flood Watch']. An empty array asserts no alert was in effect, not that none were checked.

daysSinceMeasurableRain.description: Whole days since the last hour with more than 1mm of rain. Absent when no measurable rain appears anywhere in the collector's record, in which case dryRecordDays gives what is actually known instead — the two are never both present, so a consumer cannot mistake the record's length for a drought length.

dryRecordDays.description: Length in days of the observation record searched, present only when it contains no measurable rain at all. Means 'at least this long, and possibly longer' — the collector cannot see before its first row. Not a drought duration.

fireRisk.description: Weather agent's assessment of fire weather risk. Not currently populated: Weather/agent.py returns only summary, flagged and reasoning, so there is no assessment to carry here.

pm25Aqi.description: PM2.5 Air Quality Index value. Primary wildfire smoke indicator.

pm25Rising.description: True if PM2.5 AQI has risen ≥20 points in the last 3 hours.

pm25ChangeAqi.description: Change in PM2.5 AQI over the last 3 hours. Positive = rising.

smokeDetected.description: True if pattern suggests wildfire smoke (PM2.5 spike without corresponding ozone rise).

fireData.description: Fire-specific observation fields (NASA FIRMS satellite hotspot detection). All optional.

source.description: VIIRS satellite source(s) polled, comma-separated if more than one. e.g. 'VIIRS_SNPP_NRT,VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT,VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT'.

nearestHotspotDistanceMi.description: Distance in miles from home coordinates to the nearest hotspot used in this observation. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

nearestHotspotConfidence.description: FIRMS confidence for the nearest hotspot: VIIRS uses l/n/h (low/nominal/high).

nearestHotspotFrpMw.description: Fire Radiative Power (MW) for the nearest hotspot. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

maxHotspotFrpMw.description: Highest Fire Radiative Power in MW among hotspots in the same currency window the nearestHotspot fields are drawn from. Published because nearest is not a proxy for most significant: within a cluster it is close to arbitrary which detection is nearest, and on 2026-09-09 a record carried nearestHotspotFrpMw 7.47 at the 79th percentile while its own summary described the same 0.4-mile cluster as holding detections at 24.1-33.5 MW and the 96th-98th percentiles. Stringified - DAG-CBOR has no float type.

maxHotspotDistanceMi.description: Distance in miles to the hotspot reported in maxHotspotFrpMw. May be the same hotspot as nearestHotspotDistanceMi; the fields are always both present so a reader never has to infer that from an omission. Stringified - DAG-CBOR has no float type.

maxHotspotConfidence.description: Confidence of the hotspot reported in maxHotspotFrpMw, in FIRMS's own encoding (l/n/h or 0-100). The most energetic detection is not necessarily the nearest one, so this can differ from nearestHotspotConfidence.

maxHotspotFrpPercentile.description: Where maxHotspotFrpMw sits in the publishing collector's own FRP history, 0-100. Same baseline and same caveat as nearestHotspotFrpPercentile: relative to this collector's record only, never to the fire history of the region.

nearestHotspotFrpPercentile.description: Where nearestHotspotFrpMw sits in the publishing collector's own FRP history, 0-100. Present so a consumer can tell an ordinary reading from an unusual one without a raw MW figure it has no baseline for. Relative to this collector's record only, never to the fire history of the region.

nearestHotspotIncidentName.description: Name of the CAL FIRE incident matching the nearest hotspot, if one does. Present means the detection is a human-confirmed named fire. ABSENT MEANS ONLY THAT NO PUBLISHED INCIDENT MATCHES — publication lags ignition, and the feed is a curated subset rather than a census (484 incidents statewide for all of 2026, no prescribed-burn category). Absence is not evidence that a detection is harmless or not a fire.

nearestHotspotIncidentContainmentPct.description: Containment percentage of the matched incident, 0-100. Only present alongside nearestHotspotIncidentName.

nearestIncidentName.description: Nearest CAL FIRE incident ACTIVELY BURNING at observedAt, statewide and independent of any hotspot. Deliberately not limited to the FIRMS bounding box: a fire outside the monitored box is invisible to the satellite feed, so this is how it becomes visible at all. Extinguished incidents are excluded - CAL FIRE's feed carries the whole year, so an unfiltered nearest-by-distance sort names a closed fire on nearly every run. Absence means no incident is listed as burning, not that none is.

nearestIncidentDistanceMi.description: Distance in miles to nearestIncidentName. Stringified — DAG-CBOR has no float type.

hotspotCount.description: Count of hotspots within the 6-hour window around observedAt.

synthesisData.description: Cross-domain synthesis observation. Published by a synthesis agent, not a domain node.

fireRisk.description: Fire risk across the region. The value 'unknown' means the domain was not observed this run. It is not a severity level, and it is the required value when the domain is absent from domainsObserved. Without it the vocabulary forced a synthesis agent to assert a level for a domain it never saw, and the least alarming option was 'none': the 2026-09-10 record set floodRisk to 'none' and described the watershed as being at normal seasonal late-summer lows, from zero watershed observations.

floodRisk.description: Flood risk across the region. The value 'unknown' means the domain was not observed this run. It is not a severity level, and it is the required value when the domain is absent from domainsObserved. Without it the vocabulary forced a synthesis agent to assert a level for a domain it never saw, and the least alarming option was 'none': the 2026-09-10 record set floodRisk to 'none' and described the watershed as being at normal seasonal late-summer lows, from zero watershed observations.

airQualityRisk.description: Air quality risk across the region. The value 'unknown' means the domain was not observed this run. It is not a severity level, and it is the required value when the domain is absent from domainsObserved. Without it the vocabulary forced a synthesis agent to assert a level for a domain it never saw, and the least alarming option was 'none': the 2026-09-10 record set floodRisk to 'none' and described the watershed as being at normal seasonal late-summer lows, from zero watershed observations.

overallRisk.description: Highest-severity view across the domains actually assessed. The value 'unknown' means the domain was not observed this run. It is not a severity level, and it is the required value when the domain is absent from domainsObserved. Without it the vocabulary forced a synthesis agent to assert a level for a domain it never saw, and the least alarming option was 'none': the 2026-09-10 record set floodRisk to 'none' and described the watershed as being at normal seasonal late-summer lows, from zero watershed observations.

domainsObserved.description: Which domain types contributed to this synthesis. e.g. ['watershed', 'weather', 'aqi']. Allows consumers to understand confidence level.

nodeCount.description: Number of distinct nodes whose observations contributed to this synthesis.

trustedPublishers.description: DIDs of nodes whose observations were used. Allows consumers to audit provenance.

reasoning.description: Full cross-domain reasoning behind this synthesis, including trajectory and seasonal context. This is what makes the record auditable on its own rather than only via the truncated Bluesky post — long-form analysis belongs here, not in flagReason.

synthesisDid.description: DID of the synthesis agent that produced this record.
